name: When should painting and finishing happen during an addition project?

mainEntity.name: When should painting and finishing happen during an addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting and finishing typically occur towards the later stages of an addition project, after major construction, plumbing, and electrical work are complete, and drywall has been installed and prepped. This timing helps protect the fresh paint from damage during other construction activities. However, some elements, like priming, might occur earlier. Careful scheduling ensures a smooth workflow and a high-quality final finish without unnecessary touch-ups or repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting and finishing usually happen late in an addition project, after major construction and drywall, to prevent damage.
